The Race to World First (RWF) is a competitive community event in World of Warcraft where top guilds race to be the first to complete a new raid on Mythic difficulty. It is an unofficial but widely recognized competition, with guilds streaming their progress, analyzing strategies, and optimizing their gameplay to defeat bosses as quickly as possible. Blizzard has since also recognized the event, even posting blog posts on when they begin. The event corresponds with Blizzard's "Hall of Fame" leaderboard. The top guilds typically include Echo, Method, and Team Liquid.

Rani is a Zandalari troll found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. A dream child version of Rani is seen with Peppers on an islet north of the Eye. Raptors are a melee ground unit of the Beast family in Warcraft Rumble. This mini gives up to three sequential uses per draw, costing 1 gold to deploy 1 raptor; 2 gold for 2 raptors; and then 3 gold for 3 raptors. Playing any other mini while the 2- or 3-raptor mini is up will shuffle the raptors back into your army's rotation. The varying number of raptors that can be summoned and their high movement speed makes them fairly versatile.

Ravenous Felhunters are felstalkers found at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah during the Battle for Val'sharah.
Ravenous Carrionstalkers are felstalkers found at the Twisted Grounds on the Broken Shore. They are also found at Deadwood Landing when Contagion Containment is up.
Ravenous Magehunters are felhounds found at Felsoul Hold in Suramar.
Rav'ik's Spare Hunting Spear drops from Poacher Rav'ik at the Shrine of Kulzi in Zul'Aman.
Ravenia is a domanaar located at the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm. They raise Behemoth Hatchlings.

Ratts' Journal, Page 317 is looted from Hidden Footlocker in Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. The footlocker requires both Oddsight Focus and Starry-Eyed Goggles to see, and is unlocked with Spare Key. The journal entry acts as an epilogue to the Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle secret.
The Ravenous Shredclaw is a shredclaw mount. At Renown level 17 with the Singularity, it can be purchased for 6,000 Voidlight Marl from Void Researcher Anomander in the Voidstorm.
Ravenous Invaders are devourers found just south of the Seat of Eternal Hymns in Bastion.
Ravenous Gorm are gorm that spawn when a player approaches a Decayed Husk in Ardenweald.
Raw Kaja'mite Chunks are pieces of kaja'mite that drop from Agitated Kaja'mentals and Jittery Shardlings at the Kaja'Coast in Zuldazar. Jazz Mokkitz wants them recovered.
Ravenous Feaster's Fang drops from The Twin Fangs in the Venomous Abyss.
Ravenholdt Assassin's Tunic is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Ravenholdt Assassin's Attire.
Ravenholdt Assassin's Spaulder is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Ravenholdt Assassin's Attire.
Ravenholdt Assassin's Mask is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Ravenholdt Assassin's Attire.
Ravenholdt Assassin's Leggings is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Ravenholdt Assassin's Attire.
Ravenholdt Assassin's Gloves is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Ravenholdt Assassin's Attire.
Ravenholdt Assassin's Boots is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Ravenholdt Assassin's Attire.
Ravenholdt Assassin's Belt is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Ravenholdt Assassin's Attire.
Ravenous Voids are shadow elementals found at the Tremaculum in the Maw during Chaos Control.
Ravager Grubs are larvae located in the Shadowglade in the Spires of Arak. Picking them creates item version.
Ravenous Dreadsqualls are dread ravens found at the Concord Observatory and Crumbling Life Archway in the Waking Shores.
Ravenous Descendants are snakeoids found in the Sacrificial Approach in the Altar of Fangs.
The Shadowblade's Murderous Omen is a raven mount and the rogue class hall mount. It is a quest reward from Hiding In Plain Sight; the quest chain starts with Dread Infiltrators.
Razor-Edged Kukri can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Weapons and Armor Outlet vendor for 40 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 50 Trader's Tender.
Razortooth Bear Cubs are baby bears found at the Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
Razorwind Axe is a world drop. The item was also available through Garrison's Salvage Yard.
